title: Media
description: Downloads, Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr, Bazarr, Immich and storage

panels.title: Download speed
panels.description: SABnzbd + qBittorrent combined, sampled once per scrape (1m).

panels.title: Library size
panels.description: Shows (Sonarr) + movies (Radarr) on disk.

panels.title: Free space for media
panels.description: Free space on the media root folder as reported by Sonarr.

panels.title: Active downloads
panels.description: SABnzbd queue + downloading torrents.

panels.title: Health issues
panels.description: Sum of the health warnings Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr and Bazarr show on their System > Status page.

targets.expr: (sum(sonarr_system_health_issues) or vector(0)) + (sum(radarr_system_health_issues) or vector(0)) + (sum(prowlarr_system_health_issues) or vector(0)) + (sum(bazarr_system_health_issues) or vector(0))

panels.title: Services
panels.description: Blackbox exporter probes for each media app.

panels.title: Transfer speed
panels.description: Uploads are drawn below the axis. Values are sampled once a minute.

panels.title: SABnzbd
panels.description: Current SABnzbd state.

panels.title: Downloaded per day
panels.description: Best viewed over 7d or 30d.

panels.title: Cutoff unmet
panels.description: Episodes that could still be upgraded to a better quality.

panels.title: Queue by state
panels.description: importBlocked usually means Sonarr can't match or move the file: check Activity > Queue.

panels.title: Wanted
panels.description: Monitored, missing and already released.

panels.title: Grabs
panels.description: Releases sent to a download client via Prowlarr.

panels.title: Jobs running
panels.description: Jobs active across all Immich queues.

panels.title: Jobs completed
panels.description: Over the selected time range.

panels.title: Jobs failed
panels.description: Over the selected time range.

panels.title: Jobs processed
panels.description: Immich creates these counters the first time a job runs, so quiet periods show no data.

panels.title: Busiest queues (range)
panels.description: Peak active jobs per queue over the selected time range.

panels.title: Disks
panels.description: /var/mnt/hdd holds the media library, /var/mnt/ssd the app volumes.

panels.title: Free space
panels.description: App volumes are hostPath-backed, so per-PVC usage would just repeat the SSD total.
